candidates.sentence: As your next senator to Virginia’s 10th Senate District, John will continue supporting the pro-life movement and be an outspoken voice for the voiceless.
And as your next state senator, John will fight to lower taxes for hard-working Virginians to ensure they are taking more of their paycheck home every month.

John believes in removing the tax burden on our veterans and their families, working with local business leaders to create good-paying jobs for veterans, and will continue his fight to ensure all our men and women in uniform are receiving the benefits they have earned.
John wants to cut burdensome regulations that limit competition, inflate health care costs, and reduces access to health care providers – particularly in rural areas like Louisa and Goochland.
